# Pokémon FireRed — Fan Remake

A from-scratch, browser-based recreation of Pokémon FireRed featuring **all 151
Gen-1 Pokémon** with their real FireRed/LeafGreen battle sprites, real base
stats, level-up learnsets, and full evolution chains.

**Fan project for personal/educational use.** Pokémon is © Nintendo / Game
Freak / Creatures Inc. Sprite art and species data are fetched from the
community-run [PokeAPI](https://pokeapi.co/). Don't distribute or monetize.

## Play

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. That's it — no build step, no server.

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Arrows / WASD | Move |
| Z / Space | A — confirm, talk, read signs, fish at water |
| X / Esc | B — cancel |
| Enter / M | Start menu — Pokédex, party, bag, save |

## What's in the game

- **Overworld**: Pallet Town, Route 1, Viridian City (Center + Mart), Route 2,
  Viridian Forest, Mt. Moon Foot Cave, Pewter City and Gym — tile-based maps
  with warps, NPCs, signs, and trainer line-of-sight.
- **Story**: Get a starter from Prof. Oak, beat your rival, cross the forest,
  defeat Brock for the Boulder Badge.
- **Battles**: Gen-3 mechanics — damage formula, type chart (no Fairy, it's
  2004), the type-based physical/special split, STAB, crits, stat stages,
  accuracy/evasion, status conditions (PSN/BRN/PAR/SLP/FRZ), confusion,
  Leech Seed, Reflect/Light Screen, multi-hit moves, fixed-damage and OHKO
  moves, Metronome, Transform, Struggle, priority, and the real Gen-3
  catch-rate formula.
- **Progression**: exp with the correct growth curves, level-up move learning
  (with move-forgetting), level evolutions, stone evolutions (stones sold at
  the Viridian Mart), PC box storage, money, a working Pokédex.
- **All 151 obtainable, single-player**: every base form spawns somewhere
  (grass, cave, or fishing with the Old Rod from the boy on Route 1); trade
  evolutions are converted to level-up at Lv. 37; legendaries are ultra-rare
  deep-cave encounters; Mew haunts Viridian Forest (1/1000).
- **Audio**: GB-style synth — chiptune loops, battle/heal/catch/evolve jingles.

## Development

```
npm install            # puppeteer-core (testing only)
npm run fetch-data     # re-download data + sprites from PokeAPI
npm run validate       # data integrity + all-151-obtainable proof
npm test               # headless browser playthrough of the opening
```

Everything except the Pokémon sprites (PNGs in `assets/sprites/`) is generated
in code: tiles, character sprites, the 5×7 bitmap font, UI chrome, and music
are all drawn/synthesized at boot.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `js/typechart.js` | Gen-3 type chart + physical/special-by-type rule |
| `js/pokemon.js`   | Stats math, exp curves, evolution, items |
| `js/maps.js`      | World maps (char grids), NPCs, trainers, encounter tables |
| `js/battle.js`    | Battle engine, move-effect interpreter, AI, catching |
| `js/overworld.js` | Movement, camera, warps, encounters, story scripts |
| `js/ui.js`        | Dialog/menus/party/bag/Pokédex widgets |
| `js/gfx.js`       | Procedural tileset, character sprites, bitmap font |
| `js/audio.js`     | WebAudio square-wave synth |
| `js/game.js`      | Boot, title, save/load (localStorage), main loop |

### Known simplifications

No EVs/natures/abilities/held items; two-turn moves (Fly, Solar Beam, …)
resolve instantly; a few utility moves (Disable, Substitute, Mimic, …) fail
gracefully; one PC box; no Surf/Cut — the demo world doesn't need them.
